title: No dependency vulnerability audit in CI or Makefile for a credential-issuing daemon
description:
.github/workflows/ci.yml runs fmt, clippy, build, test and an MSRV build. The Makefile's 'ci' target runs fmt-check, lint, test. Neither runs cargo-audit or cargo-deny, and there is no .cargo/audit.toml or deny.toml in the repo.

This project mints and signs identity credentials: Cargo.lock pulls ring 0.17, rustls 0.23, jsonwebtoken 9, x509-cert 0.2, and (under --all-features) ctap-hid-fido2 -> x509-parser. RUSTSEC advisories against exactly this set of crates are routine, and nothing here would surface one. 226 locked packages, none monitored.

Add a 'cargo audit' (or 'cargo deny check advisories bans licenses') job. It also gives the license-compliance answer that the missing package metadata does not.
